maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from OTC Link trading, market data licensing and issuer subscriptions (OTCQX/OTCQB), not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by issuers, broker-dealers and data subscribers in private markets, not by government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows organically through issuer subscriptions, data licensing and trading services; acquisitions are rare.

mission_critical.reason: Operates regulated OTC Link ATS and market tiers; issuers and broker-dealers face disruption and lost liquidity if they leave.

notes: Website text was unavailable; answers rely on prior knowledge.
